data.long_meaning: The name Deepiksh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning 'lamp' and 'Ksh' meaning 'in deep water'. This name signifies the light that shines brightly even in the darkest of situations. It is a name of strength and resilience, symbolizing the ability to overcome challenges and emerge victorious. The name Deepiksh carries the meaning “Lamp in deep water” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepiksh usually hope their child will grow to embody lamp in deep water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
